subject.title: fix(media): make wake-false direct fallback reason-aware

question: Is the internal-path Mantis artifact plus scheduler regression matrix sufficient for this PR, or must it wait for live visible generated-media proof through the proof harness or proof stack?
rationale: The code path is internal and hard to expose through normal Telegram Desktop, but the repository proof gate for external PRs still requires real after-fix behavior proof unless a maintainer explicitly accepts the narrower internal-path evidence.

options.title: Require Live Or Stack Proof
options.body: Keep the PR draft/open until redacted Telegram, gateway, terminal, or log evidence shows baseline missing or blocking the media and candidate delivering exactly once.

options.title: Accept Internal Proof
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the skipped Mantis artifact and scheduler matrix as sufficient for this hard-to-expose internal recovery path.

options.title: Pause Behind Proof Harness
options.body: Wait for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97308 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97448 to supply the stimulus and proof story before deciding this implementation.

recommendation.title: Require Live Or Stack Proof
